dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable selectors, conflicts, and help example are implemented while the no-selector path retains existing exporter/table handling.

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical names, and actionable unknown-field candidates are present, but ambiguous matching IDs retain source order rather than being sorted deterministically.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Initial field definitions are reused; additional field and selected-value pages are fetched only when indicated, with errors returned before rendering.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, multi-value, missing, and unknown value mappings are visible, but the supplied path contains no explicit CR/LF normalization and table-printer behavior is not supplied.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Headers follow selected canonical fields, each row looks up values by field ID and emits an empty cell when absent; the existing runList path reaches this table renderer.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolution and value-completion errors return before printResults; the focused changes use existing query/client structures and preserve the baseline command flow.

criticalGaps: Ambiguous --field diagnostics do not sort candidate IDs deterministically.
CR/LF normalization of selected values is not established by the supplied code or tests.
